export function makeResultMessage(sessionId: string): SDKResultSuccess {
  return {
    type: 'result',
    subtype: 'success',
    duration_ms: 0,
    duration_api_ms: 0,
    is_error: false,
    num_turns: 0,
    result: '',
    stop_reason: null,
    total_cost_usd: 0,
    usage: { ...EMPTY_USAGE },
    modelUsage: {},
    permission_denials: [],
    session_id: sessionId,
    uuid: randomUUID(),
  }
}

originalContextConclusions: Both complete core bodies, caller and wrapper match without dynamic-import replacement or capture merging. Fourteen repeated captures resolve to one real production declaration each, and all fourteen complete provider declarations match jointly with the eight bodies.

The full caller preserves generation increment, stale-generation check, both callback spreads, both delegated paths and all prior target control flow. The two complete core bodies preserve the seven teardown sites and their receiver, optionality and order.

The injected optional trusted-device callback resolves through the caller source import and concrete production supplier. No fallback getter was inserted in the env core; remote retains its real direct supplier.

The cleanup wrapper binds the original teardown receiver once, cleans before awaiting it, passes no invented arguments and returns the same handle. Only the two delegated results are wrapped; earlier auth/policy returns and rejected awaits retain their original boundaries.

The metadata helper invokes the concrete external getter once and preserves ordered namespace/cluster logical spreads; both core event payloads reference that helper. The fixed external getter has two undefined values and does not infer an internal implementation.

Caller sync is target/current slot23, presence slot3, trusted-device slot26. Env metadata is slot5 after analytics/index and before cleanupRegistry. Remote metadata is slot15 before both codeSession slots16/17. Presence uses the actual shared crypto initializer at slot2 before native UUID allocation, with debug slot4 before growthbook slot5.

Current six source postimages are exact; the earlier parsed import-neighbor and source-export evidence is reused. The current fourteen supplier source exports were separately rehashed against the active profile.
